Definition: a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol
BiblicalUsage: Disobedience leaves the man of God unburied, and the carcase of Jezebel is left as dung on the face of the field at Jezreel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the carcase is the end of rebellion: the prophet who disobeys and the queen who murders both lie unburied, and God will not honour what dishonoured Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
